body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-16T17:16Z, out of the at-tier contract review of PR #18501, record `5701552216`. ⛔ Unlabelled beyond `finding` and unassigned; grading and routing are triage's — and note the file is `packages/client`, which is **not** this seat's lane, so it is filed rather than fixed.

## What goes false when PR #18501 lands

`packages/client/src/index.ts:1514-1517`, inside the **non-exported** `normalizeSessionResponse`, carries a present-tense JSDoc sentence:

> …with one gap that is NOT this: `data.user.image` served `null` against a declared `string | undefined` (#17235, tracked separately)

PR #18501 widens `SessionUserSchema.image` to `z.string().nullish()`, so `data.user.image` is **no longer** served against a declared `string | undefined`, and #17235 is **no longer** tracked-separately-and-open. ⇒ the sentence is false the moment that PR merges.

## ⛔ Why this is small, stated so nobody over-reads it

- The function is **not exported** and the comment is **not** in any `.d.ts` ⇒ it ships to nobody. ⛔ Not a published-contract violation.
- It is a comment, ⛔ not a declaration, so no gate reads it and nothing refuses because of it.
- Measured reach: the literal `data.user.image` at head appears in **3** past-tense comments inside `packages/spec`'s own test files plus this one line in `packages/client`. Nothing else in the repo asserts the old issue list.

## ⇒ Why it is filed anyway rather than left

⭐ This is the exact shape this lane has spent the day removing: **a sentence that was true when written, describes a defect that has since been fixed, and reads present-tense to the next person who opens the file.** The `#17235, tracked separately` clause makes it worse than silence — it points a reader at a card that will be closed, which reads as 「still open, go look」.

⛔ And it does not qualify for the 「put it in a PR's Acceptance notes」 fallback: that fallback needs a namable PR or person about to touch the file, and there is none — no open PR touches `packages/client/src/index.ts`. Per the rule, a finding with no successor is filed or closed with 承接者 named; here the successor is 「whoever next edits `normalizeSessionResponse`」, which is not a person, so it gets a card.

## The fix

One sentence, past tense, or delete the clause. ⛔ Nothing else in that JSDoc block moves. ⚠️ Whoever does it should re-read the surrounding block rather than patch the one clause — the block's job is to say what `normalizeSessionResponse` compensates for, and one of its listed gaps just stopped being a gap.
